orig.credit: Azerbaijani folk song (xalq mahnısı), as printed on Azerbaijani Wikisource

stanzas: They do not braid the ends of the hair,
They do not pick the rose while it is wet,
What a love is this love,
They will not give you to me,
What shall I do, alas, alas,
What shall I do, alas, alas,
Shepherd, turn back the lamb, the lamb,
Shepherd, turn back the lamb, the lamb.
If only a day would come when I might see
The face of my coy beloved.
What shall I do, alas, alas,
What shall I do, alas, alas,

notes: Sarı gəlin, literally 'yellow bride': a fair-haired or golden-haired bride; gəlin is also a young married woman.
Line 1.4: sevda, love or passionate longing.
Lines 1.6-1.7 and 1.15-1.16: neynim (neyləyim), 'what shall I do'; aman is an exclamation, 'mercy!' or 'alas!'.
Line 1.9: bu dərənin uzunu, literally 'the length of this valley'.
Line 1.13: gün ola, 'may a day come'; the line is a wish.
Line 1.14: nazlı, coy, tender or capricious; yar, beloved.
